description: Curated allowlist of Cernion API operations exposed to MS365 Copilot. All other operations are implicitly denied. See docs/copilot-process-bridge.md.

allowlist.summary: Cross-domain entity search (companies, VNB, VDMI, ZNP, grid connection, EDM)
Load VDMI matrix context: status, open tasks, evidence count
allowlist.notes: Copilot-process wrapper — use before any draft action on a VDMI matrix

allowlist.summary: List VDMI matrices with open Verantwortlich tasks for a user
Get ZNP project metadata and graph statistics
Retrieve grid connection validation report (decision, findings, operator)
Get active VDMI matrix context for a running process job
allowlist.copilotDescription: Returns the active VDMI matrix context for a currently running process job. Read-only.

allowlist.summary: List VDMI matrices where the caller has Verantwortlich (V) role
allowlist.copilotDescription: Returns VDMI matrices where the authenticated caller holds a Verantwortlich responsibility. Read-only.

allowlist.summary: List VDMI governance findings
allowlist.copilotDescription: Returns VDMI governance findings for the current tenant. Read-only.

allowlist.summary: List VDMI findings (multi-tenant path)
allowlist.copilotDescription: Returns VDMI governance findings scoped to a specific tenant. Read-only.

allowlist.summary: Get condensed decision dossier for a VDMI task (V-role view)
allowlist.copilotDescription: Returns the condensed decision dossier for a VDMI task. Intended for the Verantwortlich actor. Read-only.

allowlist.summary: List all active ZNP workspace projects
Get ZNP project metadata and graph statistics
List Layer 0 MaStR assets loaded into a ZNP project
allowlist.copilotDescription: Returns paginated Layer 0 MaStR assets (generators, storage, loads) for a ZNP project. Read-only.

allowlist.summary: List past grid connection validation reports
allowlist.copilotDescription: Returns validation reports stored in the system, newest first. Optionally filter by grid operator ID. Read-only.

allowlist.summary: Get a specific grid connection validation report by ID
allowlist.copilotDescription: Returns the full validation report including all findings and decision. Read-only.

allowlist.summary: List connection rejection evidence packages
allowlist.copilotDescription: Returns all connection rejection evidence packages. Read-only.

allowlist.summary: Get a connection rejection evidence package by ID
allowlist.copilotDescription: Returns a single connection rejection evidence package with full details. Read-only.

allowlist.summary: Prepare VDMI matrix nomination — draft only, no write
allowlist.notes: Returns draft proposal with requiredConfirmation: true. No side effects.

allowlist.summary: Draft evidence suggestions for open VDMI tasks — no write
allowlist.notes: Returns suggestions only. No evidence is added.

allowlist.summary: Prepare grid connection validation config — draft only, no write
allowlist.notes: Returns validation configuration draft with requiredConfirmation: true. No side effects.

allowlist.summary: Inject manual evidence for a VDMI matrix (writes)
allowlist.copilotDescription: Adds manual evidence to a VDMI matrix. This action writes to the database. Requires explicit user confirmation. Not a final approval — evidence can be supplemented.
allowlist.notes: POST — creates a new evidence entry. Not reversible via this API.

allowlist.summary: Create a connection rejection evidence package (writes)
allowlist.copilotDescription: Creates a new connection rejection evidence package. This action writes to the database. Requires explicit user confirmation.
allowlist.notes: POST — creates a new document. Use connection-rejection-evidence_get to verify after creation.

allowlist.summary: Run Netzanschluss validation pipeline (deterministic, ~2 min, writes report)
allowlist.copilotDescription: Executes the deterministic 6-step grid connection validation pipeline for a grid operator. Takes up to 2 minutes. Writes a persistent validation report. Requires explicit user confirmation before starting.
allowlist.notes: No LLM involvement — identical inputs always produce identical results. Report is retrievable via grid-connection_get afterwards.

allowlist.summary: Validate Messkonzept conflict for a grid connection scenario (writes report)
allowlist.copilotDescription: Validates Messkonzept conflicts for a specified connection scenario. Writes a validation result. Requires explicit user confirmation.
allowlist.notes: Use to verify metering concept compatibility before proceeding with grid connection approval.

allowlist.summary: Run FNAV (Fernwirknetz-Anschluss-Validierung) check (writes result)
allowlist.copilotDescription: Runs the FNAV (remote control network connection) validation check. Writes a result record. Requires explicit user confirmation.
allowlist.notes: Specific to FNAV scenarios. Does not affect existing grid connection reports.

allowlist.summary: Add a planning assumption to a ZNP project (writes)
allowlist.copilotDescription: Adds a named planning assumption to a ZNP project graph. This is a write operation. Requires explicit user confirmation. Assumptions can be reviewed via getZnpProjectStatus.
allowlist.notes: Does not delete or restructure the graph. Only adds a new assumption node/annotation.

blocklist.reason: Irreversible — permanently deletes project and all graph data from PouchDB
Reverts a VDMI matrix to a previous state — potentially destructive, requires human oversight
Manual HITL override of matrix — consequential, requires explicit human authority
Reverts a HITL override — consequential, requires explicit human authority
Cryptographic signature on evidence — irreversible, legal consequence
Final nomination approval — irreversible workflow step, requires explicit human authority
Triggers nomination workflow — consequential, requires explicit human authority
Creates new VDMI matrix — consequential, not needed for Copilot read/draft workflows
Updates matrix fields — consequential edit, requires explicit human authority
Auto-detection triggers — consequential ML workflow, not Copilot-safe
Creates a new ZNP project — consequential, not needed for read/draft workflows
Bulk Layer 0 import from MaStR — long-running, consequential, not Copilot-safe
Portfolio gating decision — final approval, requires human authority
